scenarios.title: A permanent with a beginning-of-the-end-step trigger that enters during the end step does not trigger until the next turn's end step

setup.notes: Dress Down ({1}{U} enchantment with flash): when it enters draw a card; creatures lose all abilities; at the beginning of the end step, sacrifice it. A's Grizzly Bears has no abilities and is inert. B's library holds one card so that B's draw step does not lose B the game.

decisions: The end step has begun and A, holding priority, casts Dress Down tapping both Islands; it resolves and its enter trigger draws the Island.
Both players pass priority every time they receive it, with no other action, through cleanup and all of B's turn.

variants.label: cast_in_end_step
variants.expected: Dress Down does not trigger in this end step: it is still on the battlefield after cleanup and during B's turn, and is sacrificed (A's graveyard) only when B's end step begins.

variants.label: cast_in_main2
variants.delta: The step is main2 instead of end: A casts Dress Down in the postcombat main phase.
variants.expected: Dress Down's trigger fires as this turn's end step begins and it is sacrificed to A's graveyard then; it is not on the battlefield during B's turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Check that a trigger on a permanent entering in the end step is not collected by Forge's already-run end-step trigger pass.

scenarios.title: A delayed 'next end step' trigger created during the end step does not trigger until the next turn's end step

setup.notes: Otherworldly Journey ({1}{W} instant): exile target creature; at the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it. B's library holds one card so that B's draw step does not lose B the game.

decisions: The end step has begun and A, holding priority, casts Otherworldly Journey targeting its own Grizzly Bears, tapping both Plains; it resolves and exiles Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass priority every time they receive it, with no other action, through cleanup and all of B's turn.

variants.label: cast_in_end_step
variants.expected: The delayed trigger does not fire in this end step: Grizzly Bears stays in exile through the rest of this turn and all of B's turn, and returns under A's control with a +1/+1 counter (3/3) only when B's end step begins.

variants.label: cast_in_main2
variants.delta: The step is main2 instead of end: A casts Otherworldly Journey in the postcombat main phase.
variants.expected: The delayed trigger fires as this turn's end step begins: Grizzly Bears returns under A's control with a +1/+1 counter (3/3) at that moment and stays on the battlefield during B's turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the delayed trigger as Mode$ Phase | Phase$ End of Turn; confirm that one created during the end step waits for the next turn's end step.
